dct_description_sm: We collect information about physical and chemical parameters of water masses, as well as the composition of the phytoplankton and zooplankton communities occurring in Greenland waters to assess the climate change effects on primary production and on zooplankton growth, survival and reproduction. This dataset is produced within the framework of the monitoring program Nuuk Basic (www.nuuk-basic.dk), which is coordinated with another monitoring program, program Zackenberg Basic (www.zackenberg.dk). These two program are extensive cross-disciplinary ecological studies that examine the effect of climate change and variability on terrestrial and marine ecosystems.
dct_title_s: Physico-chemical parameters, biomass and species composition of phytoplankton and zooplankton in west Greenland
